title: Container sandbox behind FW_SANDBOX=container
description: Optional profile: each vendor process in a rootless podman or docker container (non-root, cap-drop ALL, read-only root, worktree read-write only, no sockets or home, egress only to the allowlist proxy) with an escape and egress self-test. The default stays the userdir sandbox.
acceptance: A curl from inside the container to a non-allowlisted host fails and is logged
Host home and the container socket are not visible inside
The fake-vendor end-to-end test passes with FW_SANDBOX=userdir and with FW_SANDBOX=container
